name: Open Science Workflows Building Blocks
abstract: Building Blocks for FAIR Open Science - profiles of OGC API Processes and various metadata standards to support open, transparent, interoperable and reproducible scientific workflows..
description: This repository is initially aimed to support the [Open Science Persistent Demonstrator](https://www.ogc.org/initiatives/open-science/) pilot, but may be further developed as a set of standards with appropriate working group governance.
